title: Tăng trưởng hay chất lượng sống · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support judging governments by wellbeing indicators rather than economic growth alone, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: National income records economic activity, but it cannot show by itself whether daily life is becoming healthier or less stressful. I support giving quality of life greater weight in government decisions, while retaining growth statistics as a resource constraint and using stable public measures of health, time and environmental conditions to prevent selective reporting.

Supporters argue that wellbeing measures can reveal losses hidden by rising national output. More production does not necessarily imply safer communities, better health or additional leisure. An economy could grow while households spend longer commuting and face worsening air quality. The example separates what is produced from how people experience their lives, making a broader measure relevant even where recorded national income is increasing. Longer commutes can accompany higher output, so growth alone cannot establish that households have gained time, health or a better everyday environment.

Opponents warn that broad indicators may be difficult to compare and easy to select for political convenience. Wellbeing includes several dimensions that may move in opposite directions and are not easily reduced to one comparable number. A government able to change weights or publish only favourable measures can present a reassuring picture while avoiding scrutiny of worsening conditions. An independent statistical body could publish fixed definitions and historical series for every indicator, requiring governments to explain deteriorating results instead of replacing inconvenient measures with more favourable ones. A stable and transparent set of measures reduces selective reporting, while retaining output data helps reveal whether proposed wellbeing gains rest on sustainable resources. A published dashboard should expose trade-offs between income, health and time while retaining economic statistics, rather than allow governments to select whichever indicator flatters their record.

A broader assessment is therefore preferable because growth can coexist with worsening lives; its credibility depends on publishing the same indicators consistently and showing the economic resources needed to sustain improvements in wellbeing.

exercises.question: Chọn thesis đáp ứng đủ câu hỏi và có thể bảo vệ bằng hai đoạn thân bài.
options: The issue of judging governments by wellbeing indicators rather than economic growth alone is very important in modern society and has many different opinions.
I completely support judging governments by wellbeing indicators rather than economic growth alone in every circumstance, regardless of its consequences.

I support giving quality of life greater weight in government decisions, while retaining growth statistics as a resource constraint and using stable public measures of health, time and environmental conditions to prevent selective reporting.
exercises.explanation: Thesis vừa tăng trọng số chất lượng sống vừa giữ giới hạn nguồn lực. Các thước đo ổn định là điều kiện chống lựa chọn số liệu có lợi, vì mở rộng đánh giá sẽ vô ích nếu chính phủ tùy đổi tiêu chí.

exercises.question: Vì sao bảng nhiều chỉ số cần giữ định nghĩa ổn định qua thời gian?
options: Vì định nghĩa cố định bảo đảm tất cả chỉ số sẽ luôn cùng tăng hoặc cùng giảm.
Vì có chỉ số sức khỏe là có thể bỏ hoàn toàn dữ liệu về nguồn lực kinh tế.
Vì thay thước đo có thể che kết quả xấu và ngăn công chúng thấy đánh đổi giữa thu nhập, sức khỏe và thời gian.
exercises.explanation: Vì thay thước đo có thể che kết quả xấu và ngăn công chúng thấy đánh đổi giữa thu nhập, sức khỏe và thời gian. Tách chỉ số giúp thấy điều mà điểm tổng hợp có thể che. Người dân có thể không chấp nhận dùng tăng thu nhập để bù sức khỏe giảm; công khai đánh đổi khiến lựa chọn giá trị được tranh luận thay vì giấu trong trọng số.
